propositions: A hybrid read-only metric derivation must read raw event files for multi-occurrence metrics (attempts, rework windows, reopen counts) and compiled state for single-terminal-value metrics (first-pass-rate, revert-recovery).
Metrics reading raw events must use existing reducer helpers (event_sort_key, is_active_event, RETIRED_SUFFIX) to sort, filter retired events, and skip snapshots — not reinvent file handling.

Attempts_per_ticket counts distinct claim sessions from open→in_progress STATUS edges; first_pass_rate filters by absent last_reopened_at; rework_within_days(n) counts closed→open→closed edges within n days; reopen_recovery counts closed→open edges; revert_recovery counts tickets with substantive (STATUS/COMMITS target) reverts.
Empty date ranges return None (Unavailable); populated ranges with zero qualifying events return 0 (measured zero).
Metrics are registered into the registry as structural-source, high-confidence, authoritative read-only derivations.

Unit tests verify two distinct sessions yield attempts==2, 3-day closed→open→closed window counts in 7-day rework but not 10-day, first-pass includes never-reopened tickets, revert filters on target_event_type, and retired events are included.
